description:
List captured user journeys (signup and onboarding, checkout, booking, search, marketplace,
and task flows such as building a board) with step counts and flow type, 40 at a time. A
flowType marked typeInferred was read from the flow's first steps; flows with no type are
left out of a flowType filter and counted in untyped. get_flow gives the steps.

flowType.description: Only return flows of this type. Untyped flows are counted, not shown.

offset.description: Results to skip; pass nextOffset from the previous page.

name: list_flows
title: List captured onboarding flows
